question: What is claimed to have become known to the speaker solely by the grace of the lord of the Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
Knowledge arises by that lord's grace.
What has become known is the determination of the Kaulas.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaulas.
uncertainties: Mode of that knowledge is not specified
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaulas.
